en: By the moon's light and\nthe storm's winds, may we\nreceive Her blessings...
Captain, is that you?
This is the prayer we give\nto <font color=yellow>Irisa</font> above.
She is a goddess widely\nworshiped by the people\nof our planet―Elicoor II.
Oh, it's nothing.
Lady Nel seems...unhappy.

I'm not surprised. More
than any other holiday of
the year, Lady Nel looks
forward to celebrating
<font color=yellow>Shar's</font> <font color=yellow>Spirit Festival</font>. She
won't be able to do that
out here, so far away from
home.

The Spirit Festival is one
of our many traditions
deeply rooted in religion. It
is a time we dedicate to
celebrating the dead.

Around this time of year,
the main streets of
Aquaria are lined with
shops that welcome the
souls of those who have
passed.

Nel and the other <font color=yellow>Crimson
Blades</font> often don special
white gowns made in
honor of the occasion.

They are charged with
guiding the souls of the
dead and help manage the
event.

At night, we send out
lanterns on tiny boats
from bridges into the river
to allow the spirits safe
passage back.
The brightly-lit waters are\nquite a beautiful sight to\nlook upon.

Nel will do anything for her
country, including
sacrificing her
subordinates and herself.

This holiday holds great
significance to her, as it is
when she sends her
thoughts and prayers out
to those who have lost
their lives.
Seeing as she can't\nproperly celebrate the\nfestival this year...
...She has been praying\nharder than ever before.
Seeing Nel like this is\npainful...
Yeah...

You're saying you want to\nhold the Spirit Festival in\nthe ship!?
Yes, exactly, Lady Nel!

While it won't be anywhere
near as big as the one in
Aquios, it will still be
grand!
I'll cook lots and lots of\nfoods for the stalls.

And I'll get started on
making your white gown
for the festivities, Lady
Nel!
We can ask the others to\ncraft the lanterns.
...And then release them\ninto the river!

...Hmm. Actually, maybe
that last part isn't feasible
since this place has no
rivers. We can probably
release them into the
"star ocean," though!

Are you sure you are fine
with this, Captain? You
are in a hurry to get
home, after all...
I love, love, love festivals!
I, too, would like to mourn\nthose who have passed.
I want to know more about\nyour customs.
Captain, you seem more\nenthusiastic about this\nthan we do...

While the Spirit Festival
can often become quite
boisterous, it is still a
holiday dedicated to
commemorating the dead.
It is my hope that that will\nnot be forgotten.

That said, please allow me
to thank you. I cannot tell
you how happy I am to
see that you have an
interest in helping us
celebrate this wonderful
occasion.
Thank you.
...That reminds me, you,\ntoo, are a soldier....
I am glad to know that we\ncan appreciate this day in\nthe same way, <player>.
You want to know more\nabout us?

I am very happy to hear
you are interested in the
Kingdom of Aquaira and
our religion!
Indeed. Don't ever hesitate\nto ask us any questions\nyou might have!
Lady Nel? Are you feeling\nall right? Your face is\nbright red...
*Gasp* Tynave, don't say\nsuch things! You're\nembarrassing her!
Huh?

R-regardless, I'd like to
thank you for allowing us
to hold the Spirit Festival
here.
Now then, let's set about\nour tasks!
Farleen, you are on\ncooking duty!
Yes, ma'am!

Tynave, you will be making
my gown. It is a rather
demanding task, so I shall
be assisting you.
Lady Nel, I cannot agree\nto that! I can do it just\nfine on my own!

Captain, I apologize in
advance for the trouble,
but might I ask you to
help by gathering the
necessary materials for
the lanterns?
Thank you.
Let's make this the best\nSpirit Festival yet!
You bet!!!

tapping the Achievement
Button.

Captain, did you have a
tough time? Scooping
<font color=green>sooties</font> is pretty difficult,
isn't it?
Coro! How dare you!\nThose <font color=green>juicy berry</font> <font color=green>candies</font>\nwere mine!
Yes, but Eve, I had no\nchoice. You ate my <font color=green>Gerel\nJelly</font>!
Don't worry you two. I'll\nmake some more, so\nthere's no need to fight!
... It was a very lively and\nwonderful Spirit Festival.

Come on, everyone! We're
about to release the
lanterns into the star
ocean! Get ready!
Y-yes!
It's so beautiful...
Indeed. It is almost like\nbeing back home...
...May Irisa bless you...
<player>, will you pray with\nus?

Thank you. With all this
light, the souls of the
dead should be able to
rest well.

As a Crimson Blade and
member of the queen's
personal guard, every day
my life and the lives of
those around me are on
the line.

I am responsible for
everyone under my
command and their deaths
are on my hands, as are
those I have killed on the
battlefield.
Not a single one of them\ncan be brought back from\nthe dead.

I cannot deny the cruel
deeds I have committed
and the terrible
commands I have had to
make...

I'd like to believe the lives
of every single one of
those people meant
something.
You understand? I am\nimmensely glad to hear\nthat.
That reminds me―I'd like\nto give you this.
<font color=yellow>A Maiden of Irisa</font>.
...Or at least it looks a lot\nlike one.

Maidens of Irisa are the
flower of Irisa―the
goddess of the moon and
storms.

It is customary to give
them as a gift to friends
and family who are
planning to travel. It keeps
them safe during their
journey.
I came across this by\nchance while out\ninvestigating the area.
Will you accept this gift?

Oh, Nel! You found one! It
must have given you quite
some trouble! You were
looking for it well past
sunset.
Tynave! Can you take over\nthe sootie scooping stall?
What!? ...But I thought we\nclosed that stall\nalready...?
Aaaah!!!

Ahem. What I wanted to
say is that so long as you
have this flower, your
voyage home will go well.

Once you make it back,
please do come and visit
us in the Royal Kingdom of
Aquaria.
I hope you will one day\nsee the real Spirit Festival\nin person.
